applies_to: gate 15 (encoder leakage), empirical part, all V6 versions from V6.4 on
preregistered_text: at g = 0 every operational feature is EXACTLY affine in the input history (superposition test, tol 1e-10) and no nonlinear class exceeds null99 + 0.02 at g = 0
preregistered_class_score: mean member capacity on ALL = R+P+J+Q
defect: implementation compared the MAX member of each class (and additionally the non-V6 families x_P1P1, x_P2P1, up to 72 targets) with null99 + 0.02, while the text says 'no nonlinear class exceeds null99 + 0.02' and defines the class score as the mean member capacity
evidence: null simulation (features independent of the input, full rank K, T = 1600): per-row P(max-member excess > 0.02) = 0.013 (K 24), 0.033 (K 32), 0.077 (K 46), i.e. the max-member rule false-alarms on 74% / 97% / 100% of 100-row g = 0 blocks
disclosure: found while diagnosing the V6.3 dev failure (max-member excess 0.0219). V6.3 also failed gate 17 as preregistered and stays rejected. The exact-affinity part of gate 15 is unchanged. The max-member statistic is still computed and reported.
not_changed: thresholds (0.02), sentinels 17/18 (preregistered as max member, unchanged)
